headline: Vamos Reports Q3 Net Income of R$150.9 Million, Up 199%
summary: Vamos reported a net income of R$150.9 million in the third quarter of 2026, marking a 199 percent increase compared to the same period in 2025. EBITDA reached R$1.035 billion, up 15.7 percent.
why: Vamos is a major Brazilian asset rental and logistics company, providing insight into domestic corporate investment and heavy equipment demand.

impacts.name: Vamos
impacts.why: Triple-digit net income growth significantly enhances the company's earnings profile.
